subject: Post-call exec recap & procurement path — HelionTech
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@heliontech.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@heliontech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 16:00:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — HelionTech

Hi Emily / Raj —

Thanks for your time today — appreciate the candid discussion. Quick executive-level recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Summary of pain & goals
- Current pain: 45–90s average response times from your internal LLM endpoints under burst load; ~30% of requests fall outside SLA during peak billing windows. This impacts customer-facing search and the new onboarding assistant.
- Business goal: Get 95th pctile latency under 300ms for prioritized routes and reduce per-token cost by ~40% on generation workloads.
- Constraints: Data residency for EU customers (later phase), and procurement prefers a single-vendor SOW + monthly payment terms.

What we discussed (high level)
- Redwood inference runtime can provide predictable latency with Dedicated capacity + automatic prefix caching for your onboarding assistant.
- Short-term: pilot on Dedicated with two GPU pools (search + onboarding) for 3 months to validate latency and unit economics.
- Long-term: rollout across EU region and integrate with your KMS for keys.

Open/risks for execs
- Procurement path: need clarification whether Legal requires a SOC2 and explicit data processing addendum before signature.
- SLA escalation: HelionTech requested a 99.9% uptime target for Dedicated; that will require an SLA exception and a short approval with our CS/Operations.
- Executive sponsor alignment: Emily — need high-level signoff to prioritize internal engineering resources for pilot.

Proposed next steps
1) Redwood to send MAP (mutual action plan) and pilot SOW by Thu 11 Feb — attach v1.
2) HelionTech to share procurement/PO contact and any required legal templates (Raj?) by Mon 15 Feb.
3) Schedule technical scoping session with Rishi for pilot integration — target week of 22 Feb.

Attachments: HelionTech-MAP-v1.pdf (attached), SLA-exception-request.docx (draft)

If this aligns, I’ll loop in our legal and CS leads next.

Thanks again —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

--
Redwood Inference — Production-grade LLM inference

From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@heliontech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@heliontech.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap & procurement path — HelionTech

Marissa —

This is great, thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick notes from my side:

- The business outcome here is straightforward — improving onboarding conversion by reducing latency and cheaper generation costs frees up budget for more personalization experiments. I’m supportive of a pilot.
- Procurement path: Raj is our procurement lead; I’ve cc'd him. Raj — happy to have a brief sync to see if we can do a month-to-month SOW to start (with right-sizing for Q2) and then convert to a committed contract.
- Legal: We require SOC2 report and a standard DPA before signing, but we can accept it as part of the pilot SOW if it’s in flight.

Also — on the SLA target, I’m ok with an SLA exception for the pilot provided we get a documented rollback policy and a proposed remediation timeline.

I’ll sign off on the pilot from the business side once procurement confirms the path.

Best,
Emily Carter
VP Product, HelionTech
emily.carter@heliontech.com

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@heliontech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Emily Carter <emily.carter@heliontech.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call exec recap & procurement path — HelionTech

Thanks, Emily / Marissa. Quick procurement notes:

- We can proceed with a 3-month pilot on a month-to-month SOW. Need Redwood to provide a standard SOW template and indicate billing terms (net30).
- Legal will need the SOC2 Type II report and a DPA. Please send those or links to them. If SOC2 is in progress, provision a timeline.
- For SLA exception: we need a written remediation plan and a point of contact for incident escalations (name + pager).

Next actions for Redwood: send SOW + SOC2/DPA links and remediation plan. I’ve looped in our Legal (legal-admin@heliontech.com) on this thread.

—Raj Patel
Head of Procurement, HelionTech
raj.patel@heliontech.com

Marissa / Rishi —

Thanks for the notes, team. Short internal alignment and actions from Redwood:

- I’ve reviewed the pilot ask — agreed on a 3-month Dedicated pilot with two pools. Rishi, please prepare the technical scoping doc and an integration checklist for the 22 Feb session.
- Legal / SOC2: We have the SOC2 Type II report (Q4 2026) and a standard DPA we can share. I’m attaching the MAP and a draft SLA exception doc (SLA-exception-request.docx) for review.
- Escalation & POC: Rishi will be the technical POC; I’ll be the commercial escalation. Rishi, can you confirm an on-call escalation contact (name + pager) in your scoping doc?

Marissa — please send the MAP (attached) and the SOW template to Raj (procurement). I’ll be available to join the procurement sync if needed.

Thanks —
